title: A Mui Ne day: white dunes, then the red slope
summary: Be on the pale sand at Bàu Trắng from 5:00 to 7:00, use the afternoon wind on the Ham Tien beach, and walk the red dunes at sunset.

stops.name: White dunes
stops.note: Be on the pale sand from 5:00 to 7:00. The drive is 25 km, or a short ride from the beach strip.

stops.name: Ham Tien beach
stops.note: Ride the stronger kite wind from 11:00 to 16:00, October to April.

stops.name: Red dunes
stops.note: Walk the orange slope and sandboard at sunset. About 22 km from the Phan Thiet city center, and just outside town.

seoTitle: A Mui Ne day — white dunes, then the red slope
seoDescription: Bàu Trắng from 5:00 to 7:00, the Ham Tien kite window from 11:00 to 16:00, and the red dunes at sunset.
